name: When We Die
overview: Scripture reveals that death marks the end of earthly labor and wisdom, as Ecclesiastes 9:10 reminds us that in the grave there is no work or knowledge. At death, the body returns to dust while the spirit returns to God who gave it (Ecclesiastes 12:7). Yet death is not the final state, for Daniel 12:2 promises a resurrection where many will awake to either everlasting life or shame. Jesus assures believers of immediate presence with Him in paradise (Luke 23:43), affirming the hope of eternal life made possible through faith in Him (John 3:16).
